title: Endless events
description: Endless events is a mod for randomly triggering unique events in the game.
body:
**List of all events:**

1. Spawn a charged creeper
2. Complete the "Water Bucket Challenge"
3. Gives the speed effect for a few seconds
4. A magic chest with a 50% chance of exploding or with useful loot
5. A small pit appears under the player.
6. Destroys blocks under the player for a certain amount of time (if the player runs, the blocks break faster)
7. Spawns a diamond block under the player's feet for a few seconds
8. The player cannot move for several seconds.
9. The player will be struck by lightning a couple of times
10. Every second for 10 seconds, the player throws a random item from the inventory
11. Hostile mobs stop attacking the player for a few seconds.
12. A special spawner gives the player various items
13. For a few seconds, all blocks within a radius of 12 blocks acquire physics
14. A task is given: collect a random number of certain blocks from the list in a limited time.
15. The player is placed in a cage, creepers appear after 5 seconds.
16. The player's inventory changes randomly: items disappear, and random enchantments are applied to others.
17. The tablet gives you a random item and has a 50% chance of spawning a mob, disappearing after 5 seconds.
18. Solve the example in the chat in 20 seconds, otherwise you lose half your health, if the answer is correct, regeneration is given, the difficulty changes according to successes
19. Stay in the air for 30 seconds
20. It is forbidden to pick up objects for a couple of seconds
21. Players are blocked from dealing damage for 30 seconds, any damage they do is 0
22. A sphere of stone falls on the player
23. The player will have 1 XP for a couple of seconds.
24. The player is thrown a few blocks ahead
25. Leave the game within the set time, otherwise you will be kicked
26. The player is pushed away from the water for several seconds.
27. The player gets a boost for 60 seconds: picks break blocks faster, swords are more effective, while tools wear out 2 times faster
28. Scary sounds
29. The player is teleported to a room that fills with water
30. A large cylinder of blocks is formed around the player, which descend 25 blocks down, creating a "gap" under the walls of the cylinder
